messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosting-inference-usw2 · alert=latency.p99_high · value=1287ms · short spike detected
pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 created (urgency: high) — paging on-call
oncall-sarah: acked — I'm looking. pinging @oncall-mike and @lena-eng
oncall-mike: ack — checking router pool metrics + kv cache warmup. grabbing logs now
lena-eng: ack. also checking downstream redis/KV telemetry in case of hot-partition
oncall-mike: quick dump: `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep router` shows 2 routers spiking CPU, tails about 45s
oncall-mike: running `kubectl logs -l app=router -n prod --since=2m | tail -n 200` — seeing lots of `timeout writing to kv` then recoveries
akshay-eng: can we scale router horizontally? autoscaler looks healthy but bursts can overshoot single-node limits
oncall-sarah: temporarily bumping router replicas + enabling immediate pod rotation. doing a rolling restart of the two affected pods
oncall-mike: applied `kubectl scale deployment/router --replicas=6 -n prod` — watching
eva-sre: FYI alert noise suppression triggered earlier; this looks like a short-lived kv-warmup + router overload loop
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 acknowledged by oncall-sarah
oncall-mike: latency p99 dropping back to normal after scale. no 5xx spike in API gateway logs — only increased tail latency
ops-manager: any customer impact? support tickets or prod errors?
oncall-sarah: checking SLO dashboards — no error-rate breach; small latency blip for ~30s for a subset of long-context requests. no customer-facing incidents AFAICT
lena-eng: looks like KV prefix cache coldstart — we saw similar pattern last month. I'll open a follow-up to tune warmups + batching
oncall-mike: router pods stabilized. reverting replicas to 4 after cool-down
incident-bot: Incident P12345 auto-resolved by PagerDuty (duration ~3m). no escalation required
oncall-sarah: marking thread for postmortem notes. minimal customer impact, cause likely transient kv-cache warmup + router CPU burst. propose: 1) add small warmup traffic after deploys, 2) tweak suppression to avoid noisy pd pages for <60s blips
akshay-eng: +1 on warmup + maybe lower sensitivity for p99 alerts in regions with known coldstart noise
eva-sre: will adjust noise suppression rules and add a runbook snippet for oncall to check kv warmup quickly
ops-manager: thanks team. please summarise root cause + action items in the follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:
oncall-sarah: will do, filing ticket now with logs/snippets
oncall-sarah: /cc @support for visibility — no customer outreach needed at this time
(reacts: :white_check_mark: by oncall-mike, :eyes: by lena-eng)
